name: @mthines/reaper-mcp

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: Get current REAPER project info: name, track count, tempo, time signature, sample rate, transport state

tools.name: list_tracks
tools.description: List all tracks in the current REAPER project with name, index, volume, mute/solo state, and folder structure

tools.name: get_track_properties
tools.description: Get detailed properties of a specific track including volume, pan, mute, solo, and FX chain

tools.name: set_track_property
tools.description: Set a track property: volume (dB), pan (-1.0 to 1.0), mute/solo/recordArm/phase (0/1), input (REAPER input index)

property.description: Property to set: volume (dB), pan (-1.0–1.0), mute/solo/recordArm/phase (0 or 1), input (REAPER input index, -1=no input)

value.description: Value: volume in dB, pan -1.0–1.0, mute/solo/recordArm/phase 0 or 1, input = REAPER input index

tools.name: add_fx
tools.description: Add an FX plugin to a track by name (e.g. "ReaEQ", "JS: Schwa's Spectral Analyzer", "VST: Pro-Q 3")

position.description: Position in FX chain (-1 or omit for end)

tools.name: remove_fx
tools.description: Remove an FX plugin from a track by its index in the FX chain

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

tools.name: get_fx_parameters
tools.description: List parameters of an FX plugin with current values and ranges. Supports filtering by name pattern, changed-only filter, and pagination. For a quick summary of active EQ bands or compressor settings, use analyze_fx instead.

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

namePattern.description: Filter params by name (case-insensitive substring match, e.g. "Gain", "Band 1")

changedOnly.description: Only return params that appear non-default (value differs from minimum or formatted value suggests activity)

tools.name: analyze_fx
tools.description: Analyze an FX plugin and return a compact summary: FX name, preset, and notable (non-default) parameters. For EQ plugins, detects active bands with frequency/gain/Q/shape. For compressors, extracts threshold/ratio/attack/release/makeup. Use this before get_fx_parameters to understand what a plugin is doing without reading 500+ parameters.

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

tools.name: set_fx_parameter
tools.description: Set a specific FX parameter value (normalized 0.0–1.0)

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

tools.name: set_fx_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable (bypass) an FX plugin on a track

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

tools.name: set_fx_offline
tools.description: Set an FX plugin online or offline. Offline FX uses no CPU but preserves settings.

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

tools.name: read_track_meters
tools.description: Read real-time peak and RMS levels (in dB) for a track. Returns L/R peak and RMS values.

tools.name: read_track_spectrum
tools.description: Read real-time FFT frequency spectrum data for a track. Auto-inserts the MCP Spectrum Analyzer JSFX if not present. Returns frequency bins in dB from 0 Hz to Nyquist.

tools.name: play
tools.description: Start playback in REAPER

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Stop playback/recording in REAPER

tools.name: record
tools.description: Start recording in REAPER (arms must be set on target tracks)

tools.name: get_transport_state
tools.description: Get current transport state: play/record/pause status, cursor positions, tempo, time signature

tools.name: set_cursor_position
tools.description: Move the edit cursor to a specific position in seconds from project start

position.description: Position in seconds from project start

tools.name: list_available_fx
tools.description: Enumerate all installed FX plugins in REAPER (VST, VST3, JS, CLAP, AU) with an optional category filter

tools.name: search_fx
tools.description: Search installed FX plugins by name (case-insensitive substring match)

query.description: Search term to match against FX plugin names

tools.name: get_fx_preset_list
tools.description: List all available presets for a specific FX plugin on a track

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

tools.name: set_fx_preset
tools.description: Apply a named preset to an FX plugin on a track

fxIndex.description: Zero-based FX index in the chain

tools.name: snapshot_save
tools.description: Save the current mixer state as a named snapshot. Stored in .reaper-mcp/snapshots/ alongside the project file (falls back to global bridge dir for unsaved projects). Captures track volumes, pans, mutes, solos, FX bypass/offline states, full FX parameter values, preset names, track names/colors, and send levels. Response includes storageLocation ("project" or "global").

includeFxParams.description: Include FX parameter values in snapshot (default true)

maxParamsPerFx.description: Max parameters to capture per FX plugin (default 500)

tools.name: snapshot_restore
tools.description: Restore a previously saved mixer snapshot by name. Reads from .reaper-mcp/snapshots/ alongside the project file (falls back to global bridge dir for unsaved projects). Restores volumes, pans, mutes, solos, FX states, and optionally FX parameters (if snapshot is v2). FX parameters are only restored when the plugin name matches the snapshot to prevent applying wrong values.

name.description: Name of the snapshot to restore

restoreTrackMeta.description: Also restore track names and colors (default false)

restoreSendLevels.description: Restore send volume/pan/mute for existing sends (default true)

tools.name: snapshot_list
tools.description: List all saved mixer snapshots for the current project. Reads from .reaper-mcp/snapshots/ alongside the project file (falls back to global bridge dir for unsaved projects). Response includes storageLocation ("project" or "global").

tools.name: snapshot_delete
tools.description: Delete a named mixer snapshot. Removes the snapshot file from .reaper-mcp/snapshots/ alongside the project file (or global bridge dir for unsaved projects). This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

name.description: Name of the snapshot to delete

tools.name: get_track_routing
tools.description: Get sends, receives, and parent/folder information for a track — useful for understanding bus structure

tools.name: read_track_lufs
tools.description: Read ITU-R BS.1770 loudness data for a track. Auto-inserts the MCP LUFS Meter JSFX if not present. Returns integrated, short-term (3s), and momentary (400ms) LUFS plus true inter-sample peak levels. Audio must be playing to accumulate data.

tools.name: read_track_correlation
tools.description: Read stereo field correlation and M/S analysis for a track. Auto-inserts the MCP Correlation Meter JSFX if not present. Returns correlation coefficient (-1 to +1), stereo width, and mid/side levels. Audio must be playing to accumulate data.

tools.name: read_track_crest
tools.description: Read crest factor (peak-to-RMS ratio) for a track. Auto-inserts the MCP Crest Factor Meter JSFX if not present. Returns crest factor in dB (higher = more dynamic, lower = over-compressed), peak hold level, and RMS level. Audio must be playing to accumulate data.

tools.name: measure_tracks
tools.description: Play audio and collect analysis measurements (LUFS, crest factor, correlation, spectrum) for one or more tracks in a single call. Handles playback start/stop automatically. LUFS supports multi-track; crest/correlation/spectrum use global gmem and are only reliable for single-track measurement. First call may be slower due to JSFX meter auto-insertion.

durationSeconds.description: How long to play for measurement (seconds)

startPosition.description: Project position to seek to before playing (seconds)

tools.name: create_midi_item
tools.description: Create an empty MIDI item on a track at a given time range (seconds). Use this before inserting notes.

startPosition.description: Start position in seconds from project start

endPosition.description: End position in seconds from project start

tools.name: list_midi_items
tools.description: List all MIDI items on a track with position, length, and note/CC counts

tools.name: get_midi_notes
tools.description: Get MIDI notes in a MIDI item. Supports pagination with offset/limit for large items. For a high-level overview of a large MIDI item, use analyze_midi instead. Returns pitch (0-127, 60=C4), velocity (0-127), position and duration in beats from item start.

limit.description: Max notes to return (default all). Use with offset to paginate large items.

tools.name: analyze_midi
tools.description: Analyze a MIDI item and return summary statistics computed in REAPER. Much more efficient than get_midi_notes for large items. Returns per-pitch stats (count, velocity min/max/avg/stddev), velocity histogram, and machine gun detection (consecutive identical velocities). Use this first to understand the MIDI data before reading individual notes.

tools.name: insert_midi_note
tools.description: Insert a single MIDI note. Pitch: 0-127 (60=C4/Middle C, 48=C3, 72=C5). Velocity: 1-127 (64=medium, 100=strong, 127=max). Position/duration in beats from item start (1.0=quarter, 0.5=eighth, 0.25=sixteenth).

startPosition.description: Start position in beats from item start

tools.name: insert_midi_notes
tools.description: Batch insert multiple MIDI notes in a single call. Pass a native array of note objects. Each note: { pitch, velocity, startPosition, duration, channel? }. Positions/durations in beats from item start (1.0=quarter, 0.5=eighth).

startPosition.description: Start position in beats from item start

tools.name: edit_midi_note
tools.description: Edit an existing MIDI note by index. Only provided fields are changed. Positions/durations in beats from item start.

startPosition.description: New start position in beats from item start

tools.name: edit_midi_notes
tools.description: Batch edit multiple MIDI notes in a single call. Much more efficient than calling edit_midi_note repeatedly. Pass a native array of edit objects, each with noteIndex and any fields to change (pitch, velocity, startPosition, duration, channel). Only provided fields are changed.

startPosition.description: New start position in beats from item start

edits.description: Array of note edits to apply

tools.name: delete_midi_note
tools.description: Delete a MIDI note by index from a MIDI item

tools.name: get_midi_cc
tools.description: Get CC (continuous controller) events from a MIDI item. Optionally filter by CC number (e.g. 1=modulation, 7=volume, 10=pan, 11=expression, 64=sustain).

tools.name: insert_midi_cc
tools.description: Insert a CC (continuous controller) event. Common CC numbers: 1=modulation, 7=volume, 10=pan, 11=expression, 64=sustain, 74=filter cutoff.

position.description: Position in beats from item start

tools.name: delete_midi_cc
tools.description: Delete a CC event by index from a MIDI item

tools.name: get_midi_item_properties
tools.description: Get detailed properties of a MIDI item including position, length, note count, CC count, mute state, and loop setting

tools.name: set_midi_item_properties
tools.description: Set MIDI item properties: position (seconds), length (seconds), mute, loop source

position.description: New position in seconds from project start

tools.name: send_midi_cc
tools.description: Send a MIDI CC (continuous controller) event in real-time to a track's MIDI output. Auto-inserts the MCP MIDI Emitter JSFX if not present. Common CC numbers: 1=modulation, 7=volume, 10=pan, 11=expression, 64=sustain, 74=filter cutoff.

tools.name: send_midi_pc
tools.description: Send a MIDI program change in real-time, optionally preceded by bank select (CC0 MSB + CC32 LSB). Auto-inserts the MCP MIDI Emitter JSFX if not present.

bankMsb.description: Bank select MSB (CC0, 0-127) — omit if no bank select needed

bankLsb.description: Bank select LSB (CC32, 0-127) — omit if no bank select needed

tools.name: send_midi_note
tools.description: Send a MIDI note-on in real-time to a track's MIDI output. If durationMs is provided, a note-off is automatically scheduled after that many milliseconds. Auto-inserts the MCP MIDI Emitter JSFX if not present.

durationMs.description: Note duration in milliseconds (≥1) — if provided, schedules an automatic note-off

tools.name: list_media_items
tools.description: List all media items on a track with position, length, name, volume, mute state, and whether it is MIDI or audio

tools.name: get_media_item_properties
tools.description: Get detailed properties of a media item: position, length, volume, fades, play rate, take info, source file

tools.name: set_media_item_properties
tools.description: Set media item properties: position (seconds), length (seconds), volume (dB), mute, fade in/out lengths, play rate

volume.description: New volume in dB (0 = unity gain)

tools.name: set_media_items_properties
tools.description: Batch set properties on multiple media items in a single call. Much more efficient than calling set_media_item_properties repeatedly. Pass a native array of item objects, each with trackIndex, itemIndex, and any properties to change.

volume.description: New volume in dB (0 = unity gain)

items.description: Array of item property updates to apply

tools.name: split_media_item
tools.description: Split a media item at a given position (absolute project time in seconds). Returns info about both resulting items.

position.description: Split position in seconds (absolute project time)

tools.name: delete_media_item
tools.description: Delete a media item from a track

tools.name: move_media_item
tools.description: Move a media item to a new position and/or a different track

tools.name: trim_media_item
tools.description: Trim a media item edges. Positive trimStart trims from the beginning (makes item shorter/later). Positive trimEnd trims from the end (makes item shorter). Negative values extend.

trimStart.description: Seconds to trim from start (positive=trim in, negative=extend)

trimEnd.description: Seconds to trim from end (positive=trim in, negative=extend)

tools.name: add_stretch_marker
tools.description: Add a stretch marker to a media item for time-stretching audio. Position is within the item (seconds from item start). Source position is the corresponding position in the original audio.

position.description: Position within the item in seconds (from item start)

sourcePosition.description: Position in source audio in seconds (defaults to same as position)

tools.name: get_stretch_markers
tools.description: List all stretch markers in a media item with their positions and source positions

tools.name: delete_stretch_marker
tools.description: Delete a stretch marker by index from a media item

tools.name: get_selected_tracks
tools.description: Get all currently selected tracks in REAPER with their indices and names

tools.name: get_time_selection
tools.description: Get the current time selection (loop selection) start and end in seconds

tools.name: set_time_selection
tools.description: Set the time selection (loop selection) to a start and end position in seconds

tools.name: list_markers
tools.description: List all project markers with index, name, position, and color

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List all project regions with index, name, start/end positions, and color

tools.name: add_marker
tools.description: Add a project marker at a position in seconds, with optional name and color

tools.name: add_region
tools.description: Add a project region with start/end in seconds, optional name and color

tools.name: delete_marker
tools.description: Delete a project marker by its marker index number

tools.name: delete_region
tools.description: Delete a project region by its region index number

tools.name: get_tempo_map
tools.description: Get all tempo and time signature change points in the project (tempo map markers)

tools.name: get_track_envelopes
tools.description: List all automation envelopes on a track (volume, pan, mute, FX params, etc.) with point counts

tools.name: get_envelope_points
tools.description: Get automation points for a track envelope with pagination. Returns time, value, shape, tension per point.

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track

tools.name: insert_envelope_point
tools.description: Insert an automation point on a track envelope at a given time with value and optional shape/tension

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track

value.description: Envelope value (scale depends on envelope type)

tools.name: delete_envelope_point
tools.description: Delete an automation point from a track envelope by point index

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track

tools.name: create_track_envelope
tools.description: Create/show an automation envelope on a track. Use envelopeName for built-in envelopes (Volume, Pan, Mute, Width, Trim Volume) or fxIndex+paramIndex for FX parameter envelopes. The envelope is made visible and active.

fxIndex.description: FX chain index (for FX parameter envelopes)

paramIndex.description: FX parameter index (required if fxIndex provided)

tools.name: set_envelope_properties
tools.description: Set properties (active, visible, armed) on a track envelope. Requires SWS extension for full support.

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track

visible.description: Set envelope visible/hidden in arrange view

armed.description: Set envelope armed for writing automation

tools.name: clear_envelope
tools.description: Delete ALL automation points from an envelope, resetting it to its default state

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track

tools.name: remove_envelope_points
tools.description: Delete automation points in a time range from a track envelope. Use to surgically remove a section of automation.

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track

timeStart.description: Start of time range in seconds (inclusive)

timeEnd.description: End of time range in seconds (exclusive)

tools.name: insert_envelope_points
tools.description: Batch insert multiple automation points on a track envelope. Much faster than repeated insert_envelope_point calls.

envelopeIndex.description: Zero-based envelope index on the track

points.description: JSON array of point objects: [{time, value, shape?, tension?}, ...]

tools.name: set_multiple_track_properties
tools.description: Batch set properties (volume, pan, mute, solo, recordArm, phase, input) on multiple tracks in a single call. Much more efficient than calling set_track_property repeatedly. Pass an array of track update objects, each with trackIndex and any properties to change.

tracks.description: Array of track property updates to apply

tools.name: setup_fx_chain
tools.description: Add multiple FX plugins to a track with optional initial parameter values in a single call. Returns the FX chain indices of added plugins. More efficient than calling add_fx and set_fx_parameter repeatedly.

fxName.description: FX plugin name (partial match supported, e.g. "ReaEQ", "VST: Pro-Q 3")

parameters.description: Initial parameter values to set after adding the plugin

plugins.description: Array of FX plugins to add, in order

tools.name: set_multiple_fx_parameters
tools.description: Batch set parameters across multiple FX plugins, potentially on different tracks, in a single call. Much faster than repeated set_fx_parameter calls. Pass an array of update objects with trackIndex, fxIndex, paramIndex, and value.

updates.description: Array of FX parameter updates to apply

tools.name: list_tool_categories
tools.description: List all available tool categories with descriptions and tool names. Use this to discover what tools are available without loading all 72+ tool schemas. Categories: project, tracks, fx, transport, midi, media, selection, markers, tempo, envelopes, analysis, discovery, snapshots, routing.

tools.name: enable_tool_category
tools.description: Signal that you intend to use tools from a specific category. All tools are already registered and available — this call returns the full list of tools in the category so you know exactly which tool names to use. Use list_tool_categories first to see all available categories.

tools.name: disable_tool_category
tools.description: Signal that you are done using tools from a specific category. This is a semantic hint to help manage your context budget — the tools remain registered but you can use this to indicate you no longer need them in the current workflow.

tools.name: analyze_track_aesthetics
tools.description: Analyze the perceptual aesthetic quality of a track's audio using Meta's Audiobox Aesthetics model (CC-BY 4.0). Bounces the track to a temp WAV file (post-FX, post-fader) and runs 4-axis perceptual quality scoring: Production Quality (PQ), Production Complexity (PC), Content Enjoyment (CE), Content Usefulness (CU). Returns scores 0-10. Requires the Python sidecar (run: node dist/apps/reaper-mcp-server/main.js setup-sidecar).

startTime.description: Start time in seconds (default: 0 or use REAPER time selection)

endTime.description: End time in seconds (default: startTime + durationSeconds)

durationSeconds.description: Duration to analyze in seconds (default 5, max 30). Ignored if endTime is provided.
